titre: Phrases C1-C2 : expressions, inversions, tournures idiomatiques

cartes.texte: I can't help but feel we're missing something.
cartes.ipa: aɪ ˈkænt ˈhelp bət ˈfiːl wɚ ˈmɪs.ɪŋ ˈsʌm.θɪŋ
cartes.def: I have the feeling something is being overlooked.

cartes.texte: That's easier said than done.
cartes.ipa: ðæts‿ˈiː.zi.ɚ ˈsed ðən ˈdʌn
cartes.def: It sounds simple, but it's hard to actually do.

cartes.texte: It goes without saying that we'll need more time.
cartes.ipa: ɪt ˈɡoʊz wɪˈðaʊt ˈseɪ.ɪŋ ðət wil ˈniːd ˈmɔːr ˈtaɪm
cartes.def: It's so obvious it doesn't need to be said.

cartes.texte: I wouldn't have bothered if I'd known.
cartes.ipa: aɪ ˈwʊd.ənt‿əv ˈbɑː.ðɚd‿ɪf‿aɪd ˈnoʊn
cartes.def: Third conditional: I wouldn't have made the effort.

cartes.texte: You might as well get it over with.
cartes.ipa: jə ˈmaɪt̬‿əz ˈwel ˈɡet̬‿ɪt̬‿ˈoʊ.vɚ wɪð
cartes.def: Do the unpleasant thing now and be done with it.

cartes.texte: I'm not entirely convinced, but I'll give it a shot.
cartes.ipa: aɪm ˈnɑːt̬‿ɪnˈtaɪr.li kənˈvɪnst bət̬‿aɪl ˈɡɪv‿ɪt̬‿ə ˈʃɑːt
cartes.def: I have doubts, but I'll try it.

cartes.texte: It's not a question of if, but when.
cartes.ipa: ɪts ˈnɑːt̬‿ə ˈkwes.tʃən‿əv‿ˈɪf bət ˈwen
cartes.def: It will happen; only the timing is uncertain.

cartes.texte: Had I known, I would have said something.
cartes.ipa: ˈhæd‿aɪ ˈnoʊn aɪ wəd‿əv ˈsed ˈsʌm.θɪŋ
cartes.def: Formal inversion: "If I had known…"

cartes.texte: No sooner had we left than it started to pour.
cartes.ipa: ˈnoʊ ˈsuː.nɚ həd wi ˈleft ðən‿ɪt ˈstɑːr.t̬ɪd tə ˈpɔːr
cartes.def: Formal inversion: it poured right after we left.

cartes.texte: Little did they know what was about to happen.
cartes.ipa: ˈlɪt̬.əl ˈdɪd ðeɪ ˈnoʊ ˈwʌt wəz‿əˈbaʊ.t̬ə ˈhæp.ən
cartes.def: Formal inversion: they had no idea what was coming.

cartes.texte: I'd rather you didn't mention it to anyone.
cartes.ipa: aɪd ˈræð.ɚ jə ˈdɪd.ən ˈmen.ʃən‿ɪt tu‿ˈen.i.wʌn
cartes.def: Polite request: please don't tell anyone (would rather + past).

cartes.texte: It's about time somebody said it out loud.
cartes.ipa: ɪts‿əˈbaʊ ˈtaɪm ˈsʌm.bɑː.di ˈsed‿ɪt̬‿aʊt ˈlaʊd
cartes.def: Finally someone said it; it should have happened sooner.

cartes.texte: For what it's worth, I think you made the right call.
cartes.ipa: fɚ ˈwʌt̬‿ɪts ˈwɝːθ aɪ ˈθɪŋk jə ˈmeɪd ðə ˈraɪt ˈkɑːl
cartes.def: Offering an opinion modestly.

cartes.texte: I'll take your word for it.
cartes.ipa: aɪl ˈteɪk jɚ ˈwɝːd fɚ‿ɪt
cartes.def: I'll believe you without checking.

cartes.texte: Let's not get ahead of ourselves.
cartes.ipa: ˈlets ˈnɑːt ˈɡet̬‿əˈhed‿əv‿ˌaʊ.ɚˈselvz
cartes.def: Let's not assume too much too soon.

cartes.texte: It's not the end of the world.
cartes.ipa: ɪts ˈnɑːt ðə ˈend‿əv ðə ˈwɝːld
cartes.def: It's not a disaster.

cartes.texte: I couldn't care less what they think.
cartes.ipa: aɪ ˈkʊd.ənt ˈker ˈles ˈwʌt ðeɪ ˈθɪŋk
cartes.def: I don't care at all.

cartes.texte: She's bound to find out sooner or later.
cartes.ipa: ʃiz ˈbaʊnd tə ˈfaɪnd‿ˈaʊt ˈsuː.nɚ‿ɚ ˈleɪ.t̬ɚ
cartes.def: She will certainly discover it at some point.

cartes.texte: We'll cross that bridge when we come to it.
cartes.ipa: wil ˈkrɑːs ðæt ˈbrɪdʒ wen wi ˈkʌm tu‿ɪt
cartes.def: We'll deal with that problem if it actually happens.

cartes.texte: He's been dragging his feet on this for weeks.
cartes.ipa: hiz bɪn ˈdræɡ.ɪŋ‿ɪz ˈfiːt̬‿ɑːn ˈðɪs fɚ ˈwiːks
cartes.def: He has been deliberately slow to act.

cartes.texte: I'm in two minds about whether to go.
cartes.ipa: aɪm‿ɪn ˈtuː ˈmaɪndz‿əˈbaʊt ˈweð.ɚ tə ˈɡoʊ
cartes.def: I can't decide.

cartes.texte: It slipped my mind, to be honest.
cartes.ipa: ɪt ˈslɪpt maɪ ˈmaɪnd tə bi ˈɑː.nɪst
cartes.def: I forgot.

cartes.texte: You can't have it both ways.
cartes.ipa: jə ˈkænt ˈhæv‿ɪt ˈboʊθ ˈweɪz
cartes.def: You can't have the benefits of two opposite choices.

cartes.texte: That's beside the point.
cartes.ipa: ðæts bɪˈsaɪd ðə ˈpɔɪnt
cartes.def: That's not relevant to the main issue.

cartes.texte: I didn't see that coming at all.
cartes.ipa: aɪ ˈdɪd.ən ˈsiː ðæt ˈkʌm.ɪŋ‿ət̬‿ˈɑːl
cartes.def: It surprised me completely.

cartes.texte: It's not worth losing sleep over.
cartes.ipa: ɪts ˈnɑːt ˈwɝːθ ˈluː.zɪŋ ˈsliːp‿ˌoʊ.vɚ
cartes.def: It's not worth worrying about.

cartes.texte: We ended up having to start all over again.
cartes.ipa: wi ˈen.dɪd‿ʌp ˈhæv.ɪŋ tə ˈstɑːr.t̬‿ɑːl ˈoʊ.vɚ əˈɡen
cartes.def: We had to begin again from the start.

cartes.texte: Whatever happens, don't let it get to you.
cartes.ipa: wʌtˈev.ɚ ˈhæp.ənz doʊn ˈlet̬‿ɪt ˈɡet tə jə
cartes.def: Don't let it upset you.

cartes.texte: He's not one to beat around the bush.
cartes.ipa: hiz ˈnɑːt ˈwʌn tə ˈbiːt̬‿əˈraʊnd ðə ˈbʊʃ
cartes.def: He speaks directly.

cartes.texte: I'd have thought you'd know better by now.
cartes.ipa: aɪd‿əv ˈθɑːt jəd ˈnoʊ ˈbet̬.ɚ baɪ ˈnaʊ
cartes.def: I expected you to have learned by now.

cartes.texte: There's no point in dwelling on it.
cartes.ipa: ðɚz ˈnoʊ ˈpɔɪnt‿ɪn ˈdwel.ɪŋ‿ɑːn‿ɪt
cartes.def: Thinking about it over and over won't help.

cartes.texte: Should you need anything, just let me know.
cartes.ipa: ˈʃʊd jə ˈniːd‿ˈen.i.θɪŋ ˈdʒʌs ˈlem.i ˈnoʊ
cartes.def: Formal inversion: "If you need anything…"

cartes.texte: She made a point of thanking everyone individually.
cartes.ipa: ʃi ˈmeɪd‿ə ˈpɔɪnt‿əv ˈθæŋ.kɪŋ ˈev.ri.wʌn ˌɪn.dəˈvɪdʒ.u.ə.li
cartes.def: She deliberately made sure to thank everyone.

cartes.texte: It turned out to be a blessing in disguise.
cartes.ipa: ɪt ˈtɝːnd‿ˈaʊt tə bi‿ə ˈbles.ɪŋ‿ɪn dɪsˈɡaɪz
cartes.def: Something bad that turned out to be good.

cartes.texte: I've got a lot on my plate at the moment.
cartes.ipa: aɪv ˈɡɑːt̬‿ə ˈlɑːt̬‿ɑːn maɪ ˈpleɪt̬‿ət ðə ˈmoʊ.mənt
cartes.def: I'm very busy right now.

cartes.texte: It's a long shot, but it might just work.
cartes.ipa: ɪts‿ə ˈlɑːŋ ˈʃɑːt bət̬‿ɪt ˈmaɪt ˈdʒʌst ˈwɝːk
cartes.def: Unlikely to succeed, but worth trying.

cartes.texte: Don't take it the wrong way.
cartes.ipa: doʊn ˈteɪk‿ɪt ðə ˈrɑːŋ ˈweɪ
cartes.def: Don't be offended.

cartes.texte: Not that it matters, but I was right.
cartes.ipa: ˈnɑːt ðət̬‿ɪt ˈmæt̬.ɚz bət̬‿aɪ wəz ˈraɪt
cartes.def: Saying it's unimportant while still pointing it out.

cartes.texte: I'm not saying it's your fault, but it isn't mine either.
cartes.ipa: aɪm ˈnɑːt ˈseɪ.ɪŋ‿ɪts jɚ ˈfɑːlt bət̬‿ɪt̬‿ˈɪz.ənt ˈmaɪn‿ˈiː.ðɚ
cartes.def: Refusing the blame without accusing.

cartes.texte: We could have done without the drama.
cartes.ipa: wi ˈkʊd‿əv ˈdʌn wɪˈðaʊt ðə ˈdrɑː.mə
cartes.def: We would have preferred not to have the drama.

cartes.texte: It remains to be seen whether it'll pay off.
cartes.ipa: ɪt rɪˈmeɪnz tə bi ˈsiːn ˈweð.ɚ ɪt̬.əl ˈpeɪ‿ˈɑːf
cartes.def: We don't know yet whether it will succeed.

cartes.texte: As far as I'm concerned, the matter is closed.
cartes.ipa: əz ˈfɑːr‿əz‿aɪm kənˈsɝːnd ðə ˈmæt̬.ɚ‿ɪz ˈkloʊzd
cartes.def: In my opinion, the discussion is over.

cartes.texte: They bent over backwards to make it work.
cartes.ipa: ðeɪ ˈbent‿ˈoʊ.vɚ ˈbæk.wɚdz tə ˈmeɪk‿ɪt ˈwɝːk
cartes.def: They tried extremely hard.

cartes.texte: I'd better get going before it gets dark.
cartes.ipa: aɪd ˈbet̬.ɚ ˈɡet ˈɡoʊ.ɪŋ bɪˈfɔːr‿ɪt ˈɡets ˈdɑːrk
cartes.def: I should leave now.

cartes.texte: That's the last thing I would have expected.
cartes.ipa: ðæts ðə ˈlæst ˈθɪŋ‿aɪ wʊd‿əv‿ɪkˈspek.tɪd
cartes.def: I didn't expect it at all.

cartes.texte: It's not as if we didn't warn them.
cartes.ipa: ɪts ˈnɑːt̬‿əz‿ɪf wi ˈdɪd.ən ˈwɔːrn‿əm
cartes.def: We did warn them.

cartes.texte: She's got a point, whether we like it or not.
cartes.ipa: ʃiz ˈɡɑːt̬‿ə ˈpɔɪnt ˈweð.ɚ wi ˈlaɪk‿ɪt̬‿ɚ ˈnɑːt
cartes.def: She's right, even if we don't want to admit it.

cartes.texte: Make of it what you will.
cartes.ipa: ˈmeɪk‿əv‿ɪt ˈwʌ.tʃə ˈwɪl
cartes.def: Interpret it however you like.

cartes.texte: I'd sooner walk than wait another hour.
cartes.ipa: aɪd ˈsuː.nɚ ˈwɑːk ðən ˈweɪt̬‿əˈnʌð.ɚ ˈaʊ.ɚ
cartes.def: I'd prefer to walk.

cartes.texte: Be that as it may, we still have a deadline.
cartes.ipa: ˈbi ðæt̬‿əz‿ɪt ˈmeɪ wi ˈstɪl ˈhæv‿ə ˈded.laɪn
cartes.def: Even so; nevertheless.
